slides.texte_overlay:
11 Etiquette Tips Every Man
Under 25 Must Know

1. Answer invitations within a day.

2. Shake hands firmly
and look them in the eye.

3. Introduce yourself first.

Don't wait to be noticed.

4. Phone off the table at meals.

The people in front of you
come first.

5. Thank staff by name.

The waiter, the driver, the guard.

6. Have something worth
talking about.

Read, ask, learn one
new thing a day.
slides.texte_sophia:
6. Have something worth
talking about.

I learn one new thing a day
on the Sophia app.

slides.texte_overlay:
7. Knock before you enter.

Every door. Every time.

8. Never trash your ex.

It says more about you
than about her.

9. Hold the elevator.

Two seconds of patience
say a lot.

10. Return calls the same day.

11. Never arrive
empty-handed.
